{"sample_id":"arvo_10865",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"lib/odp-util.c","function":"parse_odp_push_nsh_action",
    "line":2107,"var":"buf","code":"ovs_scan_len(s, &n, \"md2=0x%511[0-9a-fA-F]\", buf)",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"User-controlled hex string (up to 511 hex chars) is scanned from input into buf"},
   {"step":2,"file":"lib/odp-util.c","function":"parse_odp_push_nsh_action",
    "line":2110,"var":"mdlen","code":"ofpbuf_put_hex(&b, buf, &mdlen)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Hex string is converted to binary; mdlen holds the decoded byte count (can exceed NSH_CTX_HDRS_MAX_LEN=248)"},
   {"step":3,"file":"lib/odp-util.c","function":"parse_odp_push_nsh_action",
    "line":2116,"var":"md_size","code":"md_size = mdlen + padding",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"md_size is set to mdlen+padding without checking it is <= NSH_CTX_HDRS_MAX_LEN (248). For mdlen=249 padding=3, md_size=252 exceeds the 248-byte metadata buffer"},
   {"step":4,"file":"lib/odp-util.c","function":"parse_odp_push_nsh_action",
    "line":2129,"var":"metadata","code":"nsh_key_to_attr(actions, &nsh, metadata, md_size, false)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Passes stack buffer metadata (248 bytes) with md_size=252 to nsh_key_to_attr"},
   {"step":5,"file":"lib/odp-util.c","function":"nsh_key_to_attr",
    "line":2011,"var":"metadata","code":"nl_msg_put_unspec(buf, OVS_NSH_KEY_ATTR_MD2, metadata, md_size)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Calls nl_msg_put_unspec with md_size=252 bytes to read from 248-byte metadata buffer"},
   {"step":6,"file":"lib/netlink.c","function":"nl_msg_put_unspec",
    "line":246,"var":"data","code":"nullable_memcpy(ptr, data, size)",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Reads size=252 bytes from data (the 248-byte stack buffer metadata), causing a 4-byte stack-buffer-overflow read"}
 ],

       "line":2107,"operands":["buf"]},

      "type":"data","via":["ofpbuf_put_hex"]},
